### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Growjo

## The Fastest Growing Companies w/ Contacts & Emails

# Growjo tracks the fastest growing private companies and startups in the world. Using annual
# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &
# financials, valuation increases and other growth triggers, we have created the list below of the
# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].
# Growjo also segments lists based on Industry(e.g. [Fintech][10] [AI][11]) and Metro areas (e.g.
# [Silicon Valley][12]). Again this year as well as in 2025 we are seeing a LOT of Generative AI
# companies. the In addition, expect to see a lot of tech, clean energy and biotech companies as
# well due to the nature of venture funding and financings.

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

# 42M+

Active Users in 90+ Countries

Units Shipped Worldwide

World-Class Research Partners

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

## YOUR HOSTS

## James Royal-Lawson

Designer, digital analyst and economist. James has been experimenting with, creating and managing
digital activities since going online as a teenager in 1986 and professionally since the late 90s.

Over 100 consultancy projects spanning small companies to large multi-nationals. Using data to feed
the design process makes James’s eyes light up. His degree is in economics.

**My reason for doing what I do**
I have an endless curiosity. My work gives me the opportunity to constantly feed that curiosity and
never stop learning. I get a huge amount of satisfaction from planting the seeds that eventually
grow to allow people to make the progress they were hoping for.

*You can find James as [@beantin][107] on Twitter and [@beantin][108] on Mastodon.*

## Per Axbom

Designer, coach and visual explainer. Computer geek since 1982. Over 60 consultancy projects have
included  booking systems, search tools and citizen services, with a focus in later years on
e-health and online therapy. Per’s degree is in communication science.

**My reason for doing what I do**
I feel most rewarded when I am able to help others overcome challenges and reach “aha” moments. I’ve
found that the best way for me to do this is by listening and bridging knowledge gaps through a
multimedia language. To stay relevant, and have fun, I make sure to also push myself to learn,
explore and experiment with new formats.

*You can find Per as [@axbom][109] on Twitter and [@axbom][110] on Mastodon.*

## James Royal-Lawson

Designer, digital analyst and economist. James has been experimenting with, creating and managing
digital activities since going online as a teenager in 1986 and professionally since the late 90s.

Over 100 consultancy projects spanning small companies to large multi-nationals. Using data to feed
the design process makes James’s eyes light up. His degree is in economics.

**My reason for doing what I do**
I have an endless curiosity. My work gives me the opportunity to constantly feed that curiosity and
never stop learning. I get a huge amount of satisfaction from planting the seeds that eventually
grow to allow people to make the progress they were hoping for.

## Per Axbom

Designer, coach and visual explainer. Computer geek since 1982. Over 60 consultancy projects have
included  booking systems, search tools and citizen services, with a focus in later years on
e-health and online therapy. Per’s degree is in communication science.

**My reason for doing what I do**
I feel most rewarded when I am able to help others overcome challenges and reach “aha” moments. I’ve
found that the best way for me to do this is by listening and bridging knowledge gaps through a
multimedia language. To stay relevant, and have fun, I make sure to also push myself to learn,
explore and experiment with new formats.

# Private Equity Real Estate Specialists

Since 2003, Virtus has pioneered alternative property investment strategies, targeting needs-based
real estate that thrives in any market cycle. We focus on Healthcare, Education, Storage,
Middle-Income Housing, and emerging sectors driven by demographic shifts and societal needs. As
hands-on, data-driven, and curious investors, we are committed to fostering thriving communities.
[Explore Our Sectors][31]

## Focused Approach to Real Estate Investment

Virtus Real Estate Capital targets real estate sectors that demonstrate resilience through all
market cycles. Our core focus on healthcare, education, storage, and middle-income housing reflects
demographic trends and societal needs that drive sustainable demand. We combine deep domain
expertise with data-driven insights and hands-on asset management to unlock value and mitigate risk.
This focused strategy allows us to deliver consistent performance while fostering thriving
communities.

Our approach is not about chasing trends but about understanding the fundamental drivers behind each
sector. Whether it’s the growing senior population requiring healthcare infrastructure or the
increasing demand for affordable middle-income housing, we tailor our investments to meet real-world
needs. This ensures our portfolio remains robust in changing market conditions.

### Property Acquisions

## Cycle-Resilient Real Estate Investment Strategies

Our work is grounded in a simple belief: real estate should serve people first. Virtus operates
exclusively within a defined set of essential real estate verticals. Each sector is supported by
dedicated teams with deep operational and market-specific knowledge.

[discover our property strategies][33]

### Middle-Income Housing


Middle-income housing stands out as the most resilient segment within multifamily real estate.
Serving the largest and fastest-growing segment of U.S. renters, this sector benefits from stable
employment among essential workers and high barriers to new supply due to rising construction and
land costs. Virtus invests in diverse middle-income housing formats, including infill multifamily,
build-to-rent communities, and family-oriented housing with attractive amenities.

### Healthcare


Healthcare real estate is a cornerstone of the Virtus portfolio, driven by the aging U.S. population
and rising healthcare needs. We focus on medical outpatient buildings, life sciences facilities,
specialty healthcare properties, and senior living communities to address diverse care demands.
These properties offer stable tenant profiles and high barriers to entry, making healthcare one of
the most resilient commercial real estate sectors.

### Education


Education real estate is a vital sector that supports students from early education through doctoral
studies. Virtus focuses primarily on university and student housing, school infrastructure, and
early childhood education facilities. These properties serve diverse demographic groups and often
demonstrate countercyclical behavior, as enrollment tends to rise during economic downturns.

## Title

### Self-Storage


Self-storage facilities are integral to modern living and commerce, offering essential space
solutions for households and businesses. Virtus invests in self-storage properties that provide
adaptability in both urban and suburban settings, capitalizing on demand driven by lifestyle changes
and economic shifts.

## Thought Leadership and Insights

At Virtus, we believe knowledge drives smarter real estate decisions. Our thought leadership section
offers insights into sector trends, market dynamics, and innovative investment strategies. From
whitepapers on student housing to analyses of healthcare infrastructure, our experts share
data-driven perspectives that illuminate the evolving landscape of cycle-resilient real estate.

Stay informed with Virtus’ latest research, helping you understand how demographic shifts and
economic factors shape opportunities across our focus sectors.

#### Sector-specific diligence frameworks

#### Disciplined evaluation aligned with long-term capital horizons

#### Active involvement at both the portfolio and property level

[Closing the Gender Gap in Senior Leadership][14]

This insight report presents a global, cross-industry analysis of where progress towards gender
parity in senior leadership stands today and the structural factors that continue to shape it.
Developed by the World Economic Forum’s Centre for the New Economy and Society as part of the Global
Gender Parity Sprint, the report draws on novel data from the LinkedIn Economic Graph Research

[Nature and Biodiversity][17]

[The Regenerative Blue Economy: Pathways to Prosperity][18]

Marine ecosystems continue to degrade under pressure from warming seas, rising tides, pollution and
overuse, undermining the long-term well-being of the communities and economies that depend on them.
This report examines how to shift from the status quo – which perpetuates this decline – towards a
regenerative blue economy.
Roughly 40% of the world's population lives within 100 km of the coast. That narrow band – just 5%
of inhabited land – generates 30-50% of global GDP and concentrates ports, energy infrastructure,
aquaculture, desalination and tourism. This is where most of the regenerative blue economy will be
built. The report analyses how the interaction of four systemic levers – integrated ocean
governance, innovative and equitable finance, investment in human capacity, and advances in
